test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Four of them are sitting at each of the corners, while the other four are sitting at the exact centre of each of the sides.

G sits at one of the comers of the table. E sits second to the left of G. F is not an immediate neighbour of E. Only three people sit between F and H. B sits to the immediate left of H. A sits third to the right of C. Who sits third to the right of D?
solution:
**People** : A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H (Sitting at the table facing the center)

Four of them are sitting at each of the corners and other four are sitting at the exact center of each of the sides. 

**__Detailed solution__: **

1) G sits at one of the corners of the table and E sits second to the left of G. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54ae512989fdd1319cd0a6b414aae6937f1cc08a173910e2244c5f5955c6bde6.png] 

2) Now F is not an immediate neighbor of E and only 3 people can sit between F and H. So F and H can sit in these two places as shown. 

Case 1 : Case 2 :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59c8303ea8d1a7d733466e7735314b6b03ab5abe4afdda0b118a9bda3895679d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/309af83bcea3c0fa87e6c9c9c224d6b02c3a4ba8c4d934a57f88522a282c5229.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/309af83bcea3c0fa87e6c9c9c224d6b02c3a4ba8c4d934a57f88522a282c5229.png] 

3) B sits to the immediate left of H. So case 1 is eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0070906992cecf9a766b74f42355599cb868957517865df847a5690dfb9676c.png] 

4) A sits third to the right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60f0d02a4db284f0118e361e64d8d9d2a795ba0503a18571a2b0cc0e50ecd6da.png] 

5) Thus, D sits between A and B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae437171544b0498c5286477d5a006dfb5e3aa504507f4d4688095236dd746db.png] 

Therefore, **E sits third to the right of D.**

Hence, the correct answer is **E.**
